Created [ARCH-001](docs/specs/architecture/ARCH-001.md) and [ADR-001](docs/specs/adr/ADR-001.md): hosted architecture, mandated Org A identity, revocable sessions, coordinator-only phone access, and requirement traceability.

**Epic readiness:** all six requirements have architectural coverage, but none is unconditionally ready. Missing policy-required compliance and accessibility criteria block handoff. Booking rules and roster freshness also need resolution.

Documentation checks **PASS**; runtime checks **NOT_RUN** because no implementation exists. [Verification record](docs/specs/architecture/ARCH-001-verification.md). The approved PRD and policy remain unchanged.
